text.tspan: Hosts update existing pets/children policy with expected version.
Only changed values increment version and audit.
Settings and booking share the home advisory lock.
Existing confirmed stays are not rewritten.
resume run claims the queued row
[house changed to deny, or fingerprint differs]

g.text: [allow, or approval already covers this stay]

text.tspan: Guest or host cancellation requires explicit review and POST.
Withdrawal before booking retires queued work and decisions.
Cancelled authority cannot resume into a new visit.
Informational notes never become approval requests.

svg.text: tool error, model explains to guest
run status interrupted, claim token cleared
on conflict (kind, source_id, host_id) do nothing
verify decision matches host, status, and note
booking transaction rechecks current state under home lock
host panel shows the decision with a Retry button
